defs.def: honest and direct in what you say, sometimes in a way that other people might not like 坦率的；直率的

ex.s: “I am the last original client of Frank Lloyd Wright, still living in the home he designed for me,” Reisley said, sitting in the bright open living room of the home designed by the famous architect.
ex.t: “我是弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特最后一位健在的原始客户，至今仍住在他为我设计的房子里，”Reisley坐在由这位著名建筑师设计的明亮通透的客厅里说道。

ex.s: He co-founded the Frank Lloyd Wright Building Conservancy, an organization engaged in the preservation of all of Wright’s remaining buildings.
ex.t: 他共同创立了Frank Lloyd Wright建筑保护协会，该组织致力于保护Wright现存的所有建筑。

ex.s: Stop for a moment and consider that perhaps your friend wants some frank comments from you so that they can improve.
ex.t: 停一下，想想也许你的朋友想从你这里得到一些坦诚的评论，以便他们能改进。

ex.s: Psychologist Frank Farley has spent years studying people who jump out of planes and drive fast cars, as well as those who climb Qomolangma.
ex.t: 心理学家Frank Farley花了多年时间研究那些跳伞、开快车的人，以及那些攀登珠峰的人。

ex.s: Frank Lloyd Wright (picture 1) It’s not that I’m so smart, it’s just that I stay with problems longer.
ex.t: 弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特：并不是我多么聪明，只是我在问题上花的时间更长。

ex.s: Frank 20/10/18 Non-cash payment is the best way to go.
ex.t: 弗兰克　20/10/18　非现金支付是最好的方式。

ex.s: Frank: Yes, it’s going to be next month on the school sports field.
ex.t: 弗兰克：是的，下个月在学校运动场举行。
